title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: A foundational course on the principles and techniques of artificial intelligence, covering search, knowledge representation, and machine learning.

title: Quantum Mechanics I
description: An introduction to the fundamental concepts of quantum mechanics, including wave-particle duality, the Schrödinger equation, and quantum operators.

title: Corporate Finance
description: This course provides a comprehensive overview of financial decision-making in a corporate setting, covering topics like capital budgeting, risk, and valuation.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms
description: A deep dive into common data structures and the algorithms that operate on them. Essential for efficient software development.

title: Introduction to Astrophysics
description: Explore the cosmos, from stars and galaxies to the origins of the universe. No prior physics knowledge required.

title: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: Learn the principles of securing computer systems and networks against attacks. Covers cryptography, network security, and secure software development.
